title: Don’t Change My View: Ideological Bias Auditing in Large Language Models
findings: The proposed statistical approach reliably detects distributional shifts in model outputs resulting from religiously biased system prompts across a range of models (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4.0). The method proved effective even for short and simple prompts designed to obscure the model's religious perspective.
